checks.test: const rules = [...document.styleSheets].flatMap((s) => [...s.cssRules]).filter((r) => r.selectorText); const root = rules.filter((r) => r.selectorText.trim() === ':root'); const names = new Set(); for (const r of root) for (const p of r.style) if (p.startsWith('--')) names.add(p); return names.size >= 3;

const rules = [...document.styleSheets].flatMap((s) => [...s.cssRules]).filter((r) => r.selectorText); const own = rules.filter((r) => /card/.test(r.selectorText)); return own.length > 0 && own.every((r) => !/#[0-9a-f]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsla?\(/i.test(r.style.cssText));

const used = new Set(); for (const el of [$('.card'), ...$$('.card *')]) { const cs = getComputedStyle(el); if (el !== $('.card')) used.add(cs.color); if (parseFloat(cs.borderTopWidth) > 0) used.add(cs.borderTopColor); } return used.size <= 3;

const lum = (c) => { const [r, g, b] = c.match(/[\d.]+/g).map(Number); return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b; }; const t = lum(style('.card-title', 'color')); return t < lum(style('.card-meta', 'color')) && t < lum(style('.card-footer', 'color')) && lum(style('.card-meta', 'color')) < lum(style('.card-status', 'border-top-color'));
